Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, drug_mechanism.mechanism_of_action, drug_mechanism.action_type, target_dictionary.chembl_id aliased as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name aliased as target_name. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, drug_mechanism to target_dictionary on tid, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter where molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 and drug_mechanism.action_type = 'POSITIVE ALLOSTERIC MODULATOR'. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
